title: CAS-05897 — Living with Lucy — Virgin Media Play
text:
Programme: Living with Lucy
Broadcast / VOD service: Virgin Media Play
Date broadcast or accessed: 15.12.2025
Statute and/or regulatory code: Sections 46L(1)(b), 46J(1)(a), 46J(1)(b), 46K(2) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Short description: The complaint alleges the programme included a statement expressing intent to kill and caused distress and reputational harm to a person discussed in the programme and their family. The complaint alleges the content risks the promotion of violence and stigma against a person with mental health issues.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) & (b) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
